meta.what: Hand-labelled objection pairs, read at the dogfood-164 review from the runs' own journals.
meta.how: Each pair cites two `key`s in objection-corpus.json. A POSITIVE is one complaint restated in different words by the same run; a HARD NEGATIVE is two genuinely different complaints raised by the SAME run under the SAME rubric id — the collision population a cross-run corpus can never contain (F-432).
meta.outOfScope: Two pairs restate one complaint under DIFFERENT rubric ids (run-de555224 a51d6241745a/95e2cad7f49d and run-12dfe421 6e879fb414c7/f70eeacf14c3). `areMateriallySameObjections` gates on `a.id !== b.id` first and this WP does NOT change that gate — crossing it would need its own negative population over cross-id pairs. Recorded here so the next WP inherits the evidence, deliberately NOT graded.
